Package be.stef.rar4.blocks

Class Rar4Block

java.lang.Object
be.stef.rar4.blocks.Rar4Block
Direct Known Subclasses:
Rar4EndBlock, Rar4FileBlock, Rar4MainBlock
public abstract class Rar4Block extends Object
Base class for all RAR4 archive blocks.

RAR4 block structure (common header):

   2 bytes : CRC16
   1 byte  : block type
   2 bytes : flags
   2 bytes : header size
  [4 bytes]: additional data size (present if FLAG_HAS_ADD_SIZE is set)
Since:
1.0

  • Method Details

    • parseCommonHeader

      public int parseCommonHeader(byte[] buf, int offset, int length)
      Parses the common 7-byte header (CRC16 + type + flags + headerSize). Call this first, then parseSpecificData().
      Parameters:
      buf - buffer containing block data
      offset - start offset in buffer
      length - available bytes from offset
      Returns:
      number of bytes consumed, or -1 on error

    • parseSpecificData

      public abstract boolean parseSpecificData(byte[] buf, int offset, int length)
      Parses block-specific data after the common header. Implemented by each subclass.
      Parameters:
      buf - buffer containing block data
      offset - offset just after the common header (after parseCommonHeader consumed bytes)
      length - remaining available bytes
      Returns:
      true if parsing succeeded
